implementation.load: Exactly one store.Load for this lifecycle, apply loaded.Locale before Bind, and no automatic Save. Remembered/default selection and four dispositions stay owned by the unchanged preference store; non-null diagnostics are logged as warnings.
implementation.select: SetLocale precedes Save even for repeated selection. The existing LocalizationService suppresses duplicate same-locale LocaleChanged while the Host still retries Save. After locale events and Save, invalid epoch/permission yields null. Failed/Unknown preserve the newly selected language and do not route to PlayerSave recovery.
implementation.View: Retain old three-argument Bind and its fm.language.changed memory-only feedback. The four-argument callback returns the existing Saved/SaveFailed/Unknown result key with optional errorCode parameter. Generation and null-result guards prevent stale feedback; original button guards remain.
implementation.rootAndLease: Preferences, locator and profiles are under the same selected P/FightMatch. Verification reuses HISO activation/topology/disjoint-root helpers, requires a writable owned FileStream lease in acceptance mode, compares frozen activation bytes and rejects settings/target/ancestor links including missing-leaf cases. No no-argument preference-store constructor or real-root fallback is introduced.
implementation.lifecycle: Cancel/failure before Session revokes epoch/store/selection before stopping coroutines and unbinding, releases lease in finally and preserves diagnosis. Live Session Disable revokes selection callbacks and unbinds while retaining Session, preference store, language and lease. Enable only rebinds a live Session without Load. Destroy stops/revokes/unbinds, then disposes Session and finally releases the lease.
implementation.errorBoundary: Storage-guard failures produce HostSaveIsolationRejected. Missing resources/content and null LOC retain their existing failure categories. No success localization source, catalog fabrication, resource bridge or retry of rejected LOC actions is introduced.
implementation.preservedOtherBehavior: HISO parser/lease-helper block and CanonicalSystemRoot/DisposeSessionAndLease remain byte-identical to HISO; View button guards, binding helper, rendering/overlays and other unrelated methods remain unchanged.
